column1: # A verifier that cannot fail is not evidence. The PolyC detector was
# itself exercised against deliberately corrupted inputs, and the
# LEDGER was itself exercised against corrupted ledgers. Every
# selftest below is a real execution with a real observed result.
# The verifier never uses its own reported totals as its only input:
# the ledger checks re-derive the counts from the ROWS, and the digest
# checks re-derive the digests from the BYTES.
